normalization.title: Two Sparks Do Not Make a Cloud
normalization.overview: LinuxBTW compares local Qwen on two DGX Sparks with Claude, Grok and Codex during a Minecraft setup challenge; the video demonstrates mismatched completion and functional success, not a controlled benchmark.
normalization.whyItMatters: Hardware ownership can increase model capacity and control, but local-cloud replacement depends on accepted task outcomes, intervention, performance, tooling and real costs.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Separate creator-reported completion from verified compliance. Evaluate 128GB-node memory fit and interconnect against a single 96GB Blackwell GPU without equating capacity with measured token throughput.

archiveCall.label: Measure accepted results
archiveCall.text: Compare task compliance, elapsed human time, memory fit and fully burdened cost before assigning cloud work to local hardware.

normalization.falsification: Repeat the same Minecraft installation and world task on identical VM images with matched permissions, time limits and independent operational acceptance checks.
normalization.freshness: Creator video dated September 8, 2026; maker specifications checked in November 2026; no independently reproduced agent benchmark.
